about: Narration for the Learn how to use SVX videos. Each chapter is a list of spoken lines; {"pause": s} adds silence. Fictional people only (Alice, Bob).

chapters.title: What SVX is
lines: This is SVX.
It lets you send a file that only the person you choose can open.
Your file is locked right here, on your own computer, before it goes anywhere.
We never receive it.
The key that unlocks it is split in two.
We hold only one half, so even we can't open your file.
You can send it any way you like.
WhatsApp, email, or a USB stick.
Every copy stays locked.
And it's free.
Let's see how it works.

chapters.title: Install SVX
lines: First, get the app from getsvx dot me.
It works on Windows, and on Macs with an Apple chip.
SVX is a free beta, so it isn't signed by Apple or Microsoft yet.
That's why your computer asks you to confirm, just the first time.
On Windows, open the installer.
When you see, Windows protected your PC, click More info.
Then, Run anyway.
On a Mac, open the download and drag SVX into Applications.
Open it. If macOS can't verify it, go to System Settings, Privacy and Security,
and click Open Anyway.
You only do this once.
After that, SVX updates itself.

chapters.title: Create your account
lines: Now, create your account.
Continue with Google, or use your email address and a password.
With email, SVX sends you a six digit code.
If it doesn't arrive, check your spam folder.
Next, enter your name.
People you send files to see it, next to your email, so they know it's really you.
SVX now makes your keys, on this computer.
They never leave it.
Save a backup of your keys when it asks.
We'll come back to why that matters.

chapters.title: Send a file
lines: Let's send a file.
Alice wants to send a project plan to Bob.
She drops the file into SVX,
and types Bob's email address.
The green tick means Bob has an SVX account, and it's really his.
Next, her controls.
Ask me before each open, means Bob has to wait for her approval.
One time, means he can open it only once.
And she can choose when it stops opening.
She clicks, Encrypt and send.
SVX asks her to confirm it's her, with Touch ID, Windows Hello, or her password.
Her file is now locked, in a new file ending in dot S V X.
She sends it to Bob any way she likes.
WhatsApp, email, or a USB stick.

chapters.title: Open a file you received
lines: Bob got the file.
He double-clicks it, and SVX opens it.
First, SVX checks the file.
It's really from Alice, and nobody changed it on the way.
Bob confirms it's him.
Then SVX checks Alice's rules, to see if Bob may open it now.
When it's allowed, the file is unlocked, right on Bob's computer,
and saved where only he can read it.
If anyone else gets a copy, it simply won't open for them.

chapters.title: Stay in control
lines: Alice asked to approve each open.
So when Bob tries, she gets an email, and a request in the app.
She checks it's really Bob, by phone, or in person,
and clicks Approve.
Bob's file opens a moment later.
In History, Alice sees every file she sent,
who opened it, and when.
She can make a file stop opening sooner,
or revoke it for everyone, at any time.
Revoking stops future opens.
It can't take back a copy someone already saved.

chapters.title: View-only files
lines: Some files should be read, but not kept.
For those, tick View only before sending.
Bob can read the file inside SVX.
But he can't save it, copy it, or print it.
And if he takes a screenshot, the window comes out black.
It works for PDFs, images, and Word, Excel, and PowerPoint files.
One honest note.
Nothing can stop someone taking a photo of their screen with a phone.
So only send view-only to people you trust that much.

chapters.title: Keep your keys safe
lines: Last, and important.
Your keys live only on your computer.
If you lose it, files sent to you can't be opened, unless you saved a backup.
In Settings, click, Save a backup of your keys.
Choose a recovery password, and keep the backup file somewhere safe.
Nobody can recover that password. Not even us.
On a new computer, sign in, choose Restore from your backup,
and pick your file.
Everything opens again, just like before.
That's it.
Send it, and stay in control.
Welcome to SVX.
